notes: Targets were the two engines merged 2026-11-16 (fast suites, 3-5 s). Campaigns: 10 mutants each. 9/16 non-equivalent caught before, 16/16 after (rerun). Real defect: scale-reliability bootstrap uncapped (1e9 hung; failing-first test killed at 60 s); now 0..20000. Hunt also tried confidence 0/1/95, constant items, 1-2 rows, inverted or non-numeric scale range, negative/NaN/huge/fractional IRT counts, all-right/all-wrong items: each gives a clear error or a sensible answer. Fractional counts are accepted as weights (n=35.5), which is reasonable. Verified: run_venture_tests.py scale-reliability item-response-theory (41 + 38 tests) passes; post checks clean.
